title: 電子紙顯示驅動系統
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究電泳、雙穩態與更新波形；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate electrophoresis, bistability and update waveforms. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

stages.title: 顯示原理
stages.description: 以三個技術單元逐一建立「顯示原理」的模型和可反駁的驗證證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units build models and falsifiable verification evidence for display principles.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Electric fields move charged pigments to change reflection; particle arrangements vary by platform. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Draw conceptual particle distributions under opposite fields. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.
steps.check: 提交「電泳粒子」兩狀態圖、變數單位表和預期差異；以本步判別方法說明何種結果會推翻模型。

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「電子紙顯示驅動系統」的「電泳粒子：模型與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源來源、導體、負載、回流與保護的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「訊號診所：雜訊與錯頻」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓模型的接線圖、電流方向、測點與時間戳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Electrophoretic particles: model and design” in “Electronic-paper display drivers”. Draw the source, conductor, load, return and protection boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Signal Clinic: Noise and Aliasing” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for isolated low-voltage wiring diagram, current direction, measurement points and timestamps, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 審查「電泳粒子」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for electrophoretic particles?
options: 電子紙必須以背光讓每個像素發光。
雙穩態代表整個裝置永遠不耗電。
電場推動帶電顏料改變可見反射狀態，粒子配置依平台不同。
optionsEn: Electronic paper requires a backlight to make each pixel emit.
Bistability means the entire device never consumes energy.
Electric fields move charged pigments to change reflection; particle arrangements vary by platform.
quiz.explanation: 電場推動帶電顏料改變可見反射狀態，粒子配置依平台不同。 畫出兩種極性電場下的概念粒子分布。
quiz.explanationEn: Electric fields move charged pigments to change reflection; particle arrangements vary by platform. Draw conceptual particle distributions under opposite fields.

steps.title: 電泳粒子：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「電泳粒子」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in electrophoretic particles, with traceable interpretation and evidence.

steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Draw conceptual particle distributions under opposite fields. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Electric fields move charged pigments to change reflection; particle arrangements vary by platform.” with the hypothesis to reject “Electronic paper requires a backlight to make each pixel emit.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：畫出兩種極性電場下的概念粒子分布。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Draw conceptual particle distributions under opposite fields. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 畫出兩種極性電場下的概念粒子分布。

steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：每個像素都可完全忽略列掃描時序。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Every pixel can ignore row-scan timing. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

knowledge.textEn: Eupdate=∫V(t)I(t)dt; Pavg≈Eupdate·update rate+Pidle. Assumed energy; measure actual size, content, waveform and temperature. Bistability does not imply zero whole-device standby.
